parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Container Registry instance.

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description: The ID of the image repository.

parameters.name: ScanService
parameters.description:
The type of the scanning engine.

*   `SAS_SCAN_SERVICE`: Security Center scan engine (paid service)
*   `ACR_SCAN_SERVICE`: Container Registry scan engine

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-repo-tag-scan-task --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --repo-id crr-xwvi3osiy4ff0000 --tag 1.24 --digest sha256:815386ebbe9a3490f38785ab11bda34ec8dacf4634af77b8912832d4f85dca04 --scan-service ACR_SCAN_SERVICE --scan-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
